about.heading: Sketching stories with detail, emotion, and artistry.
paragraphs: Welcome to ADEEL ART, where details, memories, and human expression are transformed into hand-drawn artwork. Every stroke is crafted to capture the essence of the subject and the feeling behind the moment.

I create sketches for portraits, special gifts, homes, and custom commissions. My process blends realism, light shading, and personal storytelling to produce artwork that feels meaningful and premium.

faq.question: How can I place an order?
faq.answer: Choose a sketch, add it to the cart, and complete checkout with your contact and delivery details.

faq.question: How does Cash on Delivery work?
faq.answer: Select Cash on Delivery at checkout. You pay when your order is delivered.

faq.question: How can I pay online?
faq.answer: Choose Online Payment during checkout to see JazzCash and NayaPay instructions.

faq.question: How does JazzCash payment work?
faq.answer: JazzCash details are shown after selecting online payment. Transfer the total and share the confirmation with the artist.

faq.question: How does NayaPay payment work?
faq.answer: After selecting online payment, NayaPay details are displayed in the checkout payment box.

faq.question: How can I order a custom sketch?
faq.answer: Contact us on WhatsApp with your reference photos and artwork requirements.

faq.question: How long does delivery take?
faq.answer: Standard orders typically take 3-7 business days after confirmation.

faq.question: Can I request a specific sketch?
faq.answer: Yes. Request custom work, a personalized portrait, or a specific reference style through the custom sketch contact option.

faq.question: How can I contact the artist?
faq.answer: Use the contact section or WhatsApp button for questions, commissions, and order updates.
